name: B10-0250/2025 (S&D) – Return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to say where all the Ukrainian children it has moved or deported are, and to let them return home safely. It asks Russia to let aid groups reach these children. It says moving children out of occupied land is a war crime. It wants the European Union and its member states to help Ukraine find these children and bring them back to their parents. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- Russia must name and locate the children and allow their return; nothing changes on the ground yet.
- The European Union and member states are asked to help Ukraine trace and bring back deported children.
- The Parliament wants any peace deal to include the children's return and accountability for the deportations.
